decision_criterion.question: Does poppler earn its system dependency?
decision_criterion.unit: one passage check: is this quotation found in this document under this reader
decision_criterion.outcome_compared: found / not found, after citations.verify normalization
decision_criterion.drop_poppler_if: the pure-Python readers reproduce poppler's outcome on every passage check (divergences == 0)
decision_criterion.small_divergence_if: fewer than 1 per cent of passage checks diverge; each is then reported individually with its document, its passage and its cause
decision_criterion.substantial_divergence_if: 1 per cent or more of passage checks diverge, in which case poppler stays and triangulation is worth building
directions_reported_separately: poppler_only: poppler found the passage and the pure-Python reader did not
python_only: the pure-Python reader found the passage and poppler did not
decision_criterion.pooling_forbidden: the two directions are never pooled into one disagreement rate; a pure-Python reader that is sometimes better matters as much as the reverse
